questions.prompt: Research is pushing the frontiers of ecology in ___________ regions of the planet.
questions.explanation: Bài nghe đề cập: 'carried out in the remoter regions of our planet'.

questions.prompt: Organisms that can survive in the most extreme environments are known as ___________.
questions.explanation: Thuật ngữ được định nghĩa: 'grouped into what is now known as extremophiles'.

questions.prompt: The research discussed was carried out in ___________, one of the coldest and driest places on Earth.
questions.explanation: Địa điểm nghiên cứu: 'was carried out in Antarctica, one of the coldest and driest places on Earth'.

questions.prompt: Some of the discovered microbe colonies were identified as a type of fungus called ___________.
questions.explanation: Tên loại nấm được tìm thấy: 'a type of fungus called Beauveria bassiana'.

questions.prompt: Organisms living near the rock surface can still be warmed by the ___________.
questions.explanation: Nguồn nhiệt sưởi ấm: 'can still be warmed by the sun'.

questions.prompt: High amounts of ___________ in the soil might prevent essential water from freezing.
questions.explanation: Yếu tố giúp chống đông nước: 'very high amounts of salt in the soil might be the clue'.

questions.prompt: At very high salt levels, temperatures could drop to ___________ degrees before frost causes damage.
questions.explanation: Mức nhiệt độ giới hạn: 'could drop to -56 degrees before frost would cause any damage'.

questions.prompt: The natural process occurring in Antarctica that keeps water liquid at very low temperatures is called ___________.
questions.explanation: Tên quá trình: 'the process at work here is called supercooling'.

questions.prompt: The research suggests that extraterrestrial life might be able to survive on our neighboring planet ___________.
questions.explanation: Hàm ý về hành tinh khác: 'including on our neighboring planet Mars'.

questions.prompt: All of this research might have great significance for future unmanned space ___________.
questions.explanation: Ý nghĩa ứng dụng: 'great significance for future unmanned space missions'.

questions.prompt: Number of people accommodation is for:

questions.prompt: Employment status of the tenants:

questions.explanation: Khu vực ưu tiên hàng đầu là trung tâm thành phố ('The city centre would be good').

questions.prompt: What is the topic of Dave's project?
questions.explanation: Tutor xác nhận đề tài: 'Now, yours is the one on work placement, isn't it?' - 'Yeah, that's right'.

questions.prompt: What type of placement schemes did Dave decide to focus on?
questions.explanation: Dave trả lời về việc giới hạn phạm vi nghiên cứu: 'You've stuck to university placement schemes?' - 'Yeah, well, I quickly found that I had to limit my research'.

questions.prompt: Total number of questionnaires sent out by Dave:
questions.explanation: Dave nêu số lượng phát khảo sát: 'I sent out about 150 questionnaires altogether'.

questions.prompt: Who mostly filled in the company questionnaires?
questions.explanation: Tutor hỏi về người điền phiếu và Dave đáp: 'the idea was to have them done by the students' line managers'.

questions.prompt: What does the tutor suggest Dave should add to the back of his project?
questions.explanation: Góp ý của tutor về danh sách phản hồi: 'You can put it as an appendix at the back'.

questions.prompt: What does the tutor think Dave needs to give in the introduction?
questions.explanation: Tutor chỉ ra điểm thiếu trong phần mở đầu: 'So you think I should give a definition?' - 'Exactly'.

questions.prompt: What does the tutor suggest dividing the introduction into?
questions.explanation: Tutor gợi ý chia phần mở đầu: 'do you think it would be better to have two sections there?' - 'I do'.

questions.prompt: What aspect of preparation does Dave analyze first in his findings?
questions.explanation: Dave nói về phần phân tích đầu tiên: 'I had to look at that first... and I found a huge variation between the different institutions'.

questions.prompt: What does Dave consider to be the core of his whole project?
questions.explanation: Dave xác định trọng tâm: 'For me, this is the core of my whole project really, on key skills development'.

questions.prompt: What should Dave use to illustrate his points in the final chapter?
questions.explanation: Tutor hướng dẫn cách làm chương cuối: 'maybe you could illustrate it with quotations from the questionnaires'.

questions.prompt: Guided tours of the British Library do not include a visit to the ___________ rooms.
questions.explanation: Thông tin hạn chế vé: 'do not include a visit to the reading rooms'.

questions.prompt: Guided tours that include the reading rooms only take place on ___________.
questions.explanation: Thời gian tham quan phòng đọc: 'the only day there are tours is on Sundays'.

questions.prompt: The modern building of the British Library was first designed in the year ___________.
questions.explanation: Năm thiết kế tòa nhà: 'first designed by Sir Colin St John Wilson in 1977'.

questions.prompt: The total floor space of the library building covers ___________ square meters.
questions.explanation: Diện tích sàn: 'The total floor space here is 100,000 square meters'.

questions.prompt: The library employs a total of ___________ staff members working in the building.
questions.explanation: Số lượng nhân viên: 'has a thousand staff members based here in the building'.

questions.prompt: Outside the main entrance, visitors can see a stunning sculpture of Newton created by ___________.
questions.explanation: Tên nhà điêu khắc bức tượng Newton: 'The sculptor was Paolozzi'.

questions.prompt: On the lower ground floor, to the left of the main entrance, visitors can find the ___________.
questions.explanation: Khu vực bên trái lối vào chính ở tầng hầm dưới: 'That's the area over to the left of the main entrance... we also have a bookshop'.

questions.prompt: The glass-sided tower located in the middle of the upper ground floor is called the ___________ Library.
questions.explanation: Tên của tòa tháp kính: 'This is called the King's Library'.

questions.prompt: The King's Library was built to house the collection presented to the nation in ___________ by the King.
questions.explanation: Năm bộ sưu tập được trình cống: 'presented to the nation in 1823 by the King'.

questions.prompt: Located behind the library's treasures gallery on the way to the cafe is the ___________ display.
questions.explanation: Khu vực trưng bày trên đường tới quán cà phê: 'take a look at the stamp display situated behind it on the way to the cafe'.
